name: TasksExtensionAdvertised
description: Server advertises io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks under capabilities.extensions (and not capabilities.tasks)

name: TasksMethodsGatedWithoutExtension
description: tasks/get, tasks/update, tasks/cancel return -32021 when the client did not negotiate the tasks extension (SEP-2575 Missing Required Capabilities)
errorMessage: tasks/get MUST return -32021; got -32601; tasks/update MUST return -32021; got -32601; tasks/cancel MUST return -32021; got -32601

name: TasksToolsCallWithoutExtensionSync
description: tools/call from a session without the extension MUST fall through to sync (no CreateTaskResult, even for task-supporting tools)

name: TasksPerRequestMetaOptIn
description: tools/call with extension declared in _meta.io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities produces a CreateTaskResult even when the session did not negotiate the extension

name: WireSchemaValid
description: Every JSON-RPC message the implementation sent is valid per the spec JSON schema for the negotiated spec version
